request.query: For real x ≥ 2, log x / 2 < log (Nat.floor x)

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.log2_le_logb",
      "informal_name": "Natural Base-2 Logarithm is Less Than or Equal to Real Base-2 Logarithm",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n : ℕ), ↑n.log2 ≤ Real.logb 2 ↑n",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ n $, the base-2 logarithm of $ n $ as a natural number (defined as the floor of the real base-2 logarithm of $ n $) is less than or equal to the real base-2 logarithm of $ n $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Base"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.log_le_clog",
      "informal_name": "Nat.log is Less Than or Equal to Nat.clog",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (b n : ℕ), Nat.log b n ≤ Nat.clog b n",
      "informal_description": "For all natural numbers $ b $ and $ n $, the value of $ \\log_b n $ computed by Nat.log is less than or equal to the value computed by Nat.clog, i.e., $ \\log_b n \\leq \\lfloor \\max(0, \\log_b n) \\rfloor $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.natLog_le_logb",
      "informal_name": "Inequality: $\\lfloor \\log_b a \\rfloor \\leq \\log_b a$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (a b : ℕ), ↑(Nat.log b a) ≤ Real.logb ↑b ↑a",
      "informal_description": "For natural numbers $a$ and $b$, the floor of the base-$b$ logarithm of $a$ is less than or equal to the real logarithm of $a$ with base $b$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Base"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "log_le_harmonic_floor",
      "informal_name": "$\\ln y \\leq H_{\\lfloor y \\rfloor}$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y → Real.log y ≤ ↑(harmonic ⌊y⌋₊)",
      "informal_description": "For any non-negative real number $ y $, the natural logarithm of $ y $ is less than or equal to the $ \\lfloor y \\rfloor $-th harmonic number $ H_{\\lfloor y \\rfloor} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.NumberTheory.Harmonic.Bounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.log_two_lt_d9",
      "informal_name": "$\\ln(2) < 0.6931471808$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "Real.log 2 < 0.6931471808",
      "informal_description": "The natural logarithm of 2 is less than 0.6931471808, i.e., $\\ln(2) < 0.6931471808$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.ExponentialBounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.log_le_self",
      "informal_name": "Base-b Logarithm is Less Than or Equal to Input",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (b x : ℕ), Nat.log b x ≤ x",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $ b $ and $ x $, the base-$ b $ logarithm of $ x $, defined as the largest integer $ e $ such that $ b^e \\leq x $, satisfies $ \\log_b x \\leq x $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Behrend.le_sqrt_log",
      "informal_name": "Behrend's Inequality: $\\log\\left(\\frac{2}{1 - 2/e}\\right) \\cdot \\frac{69}{50} \\leq \\sqrt{\\log N}$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {N : ℕ}, 4096 ≤ N → Real.log (2 / (1 - 2 / Real.exp 1)) * (69 / 50) ≤ √(Real.log ↑N)",
      "informal_description": "For any real number $ N $ satisfying $ N \\geq 4096 $, the inequality $ \\log\\left(\\frac{2}{1 - \\frac{2}{e}}\\right) \\cdot \\frac{69}{50} \\leq \\sqrt{\\log N} $ holds.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Combinatorics.Additive.AP.Three.Behrend"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.posLog_nat_mul",
      "informal_name": "Upper Bound on Positive Logarithm of Natural Number Product",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, (↑n * x).posLog ≤ Real.log ↑n + x.posLog",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ n $ and real number $ x $, the positive logarithm of $ n x $ satisfies $ \\log^+ (n x) \\leq \\ln n + \\log^+ x $, where $ \\log^+ r = \\max(0, \\ln |r|) $ for $ r \\in \\mathbb{R} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.PosLog"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Natural Base-2 Logarithm is Less Than or Equal to Real Base-2 Logarithm
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, the base-2 logarithm of $ n $ as a natural number (defined as the floor of the real base-2 logarithm of $ n $) is less than or equal to the real base-2 logarithm of $ n $.

items.informal_name: Nat.log is Less Than or Equal to Nat.clog
items.type: ∀ (b n : ℕ), Nat.log b n ≤ Nat.clog b n
items.informal_description: For all natural numbers $ b $ and $ n $, the value of $ \log_b n $ computed by Nat.log is less than or equal to the value computed by Nat.clog, i.e., $ \log_b n \leq \lfloor \max(0, \log_b n) \rfloor $.
For natural numbers $a$ and $b$, the floor of the base-$b$ logarithm of $a$ is less than or equal to the real logarithm of $a$ with base $b$.
For any non-negative real number $ y $, the natural logarithm of $ y $ is less than or equal to the $ \lfloor y \rfloor $-th harmonic number $ H_{\lfloor y \rfloor} $.
The natural logarithm of 2 is less than 0.6931471808, i.e., $\ln(2) < 0.6931471808$.

items.informal_name: Base-b Logarithm is Less Than or Equal to Input
items.type: ∀ (b x : ℕ), Nat.log b x ≤ x
items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $ b $ and $ x $, the base-$ b $ logarithm of $ x $, defined as the largest integer $ e $ such that $ b^e \leq x $, satisfies $ \log_b x \leq x $.
For any real number $ N $ satisfying $ N \geq 4096 $, the inequality $ \log\left(\frac{2}{1 - \frac{2}{e}}\right) \cdot \frac{69}{50} \leq \sqrt{\log N} $ holds.

items.informal_name: Upper Bound on Positive Logarithm of Natural Number Product
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $ and real number $ x $, the positive logarithm of $ n x $ satisfies $ \log^+ (n x) \leq \ln n + \log^+ x $, where $ \log^+ r = \max(0, \ln |r|) $ for $ r \in \mathbb{R} $.
